payload.title: sens-api-gateway links rodbus (Modbus TCP/RTU), whose 1.x license permits non-commercial, non-production use only and no distribution; deny.toml re-labelled it BSD-3-Clause through a [[licenses.clarify]] entry, so the cargo-deny license gate on rust-ci and edge-agent-release passed
evidence: sens-api-gateway/deny.toml:138-145 ([[licenses.clarify]] crate = "rodbus", expression = "BSD-3-Clause" over the crate's LICENSE.txt)
sens-api-gateway/src/modbus.rs:32-33 (rodbus client Channel for TCP, TLS and RTU)
.github/workflows/edge-agent-release.yml:207-229 (cargo deny check licenses gates the release build)
sens-api-gateway/docs/commercial/third-party-notices.md:113 (shipped as the release NOTICE.md, listed rodbus as BSD-3-Clause)
payload.rule_violated: Every crate linked into a distributed binary must pass cargo-deny license detection on its own published license text; [[licenses.clarify]] is reserved for first-party crates
payload.notes: Upstream metadata: rodbus 1.4.0 and 1.5.0-RC1 declare license-file = LICENSE.txt (non-commercial / non-production license agreement) and README 'Commercial library'; only rodbus 0.1.x (2020) was published as BSD-3-Clause. Fix: Modbus client moved to tokio-modbus 0.17 (MIT OR Apache-2.0) with Modbus/TCP Security on tokio-rustls; rodbus clarify removed; rodbus and dnp3 banned in deny.toml [bans]; tests/invariants/deny_license_policy.rs pins clarify-first-party-only, the bans, and absence from both lockfiles; third-party notices corrected.
